ios.desc:
Build Lasting Habits That Stick - Transform Your Daily Routine Into Powerful Streaks

  Roots - Streak Tracker is the ultimate habit tracking app designed to help you build consistent daily routines and achieve lasting personal growth. Whether you're looking to
  improve productivity, establish healthy habits, or maintain motivation, Roots provides the perfect foundation for sustainable change.

 POWERFUL HABIT TRACKING
  Create and track unlimited habits with our intuitive interface. Monitor your daily progress, build impressive streaks, and watch your consistency grow. Each completed habit
  contributes to your personal growth journey, making self-improvement both rewarding and achievable.

 UNIQUE HABIT CHAINING
  Revolutionary habit chaining feature lets you link related habits together, creating powerful morning routines, evening rituals, or workout sequences. Build momentum by completing
  habits in order, making it easier to maintain consistency and develop lasting behavioral change.

 COMPREHENSIVE PROGRESS TRACKING
  Visualize your success with detailed analytics and beautiful progress charts. Track streak counts, completion rates, and patterns over time. Our smart insights help you identify
  what's working and where to focus your energy for maximum productivity gains.

 BEAUTIFUL TREE GROWTH VISUALIZATION
  Watch your virtual tree grow as you complete habits and maintain streaks. Six unique growth stages provide constant visual motivation, turning habit building into an engaging,
  gamified experience that keeps you coming back.

 APPLE WATCH INTEGRATION
  Complete habits directly from your Apple Watch with our native companion app. Perfect for quick check-ins during workouts, meditation sessions, or busy days when your phone isn't
  handy. Full sync ensures your progress is always up-to-date.

 HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
  Stay motivated with customizable widgets showing your daily progress and active habits. Quick glance functionality keeps your goals visible and accessible throughout the day,
  boosting accountability and consistency.

 SEAMLESS CLOUD SYNC
  Your habit data automatically syncs across all devices. Start tracking on your iPhone, check progress on your iPad, and complete habits on your Apple Watch - everything stays
  perfectly synchronized.

I recently built this habit tracker app with a built-in Pomodoro timer. It’s minimal, clean, and focused around growing a plant as you build good habits or break bad ones.

You can try it without premium or any payments so   lmk if u have any feedback.

Thanks.
